project: APP UI Studio actual review workspace and product introduction site

baseline.sample_inputs: Historical Qike screens are explicitly labeled sample inputs, not redesigned Qike output.

capture_conditions.note: Recorded image pixel dimensions differ from requested CSS viewport in IAB; actual headers are listed. Baseline/draft/final desktop images share 1425x891; baseline/final mobile images share 375x812. A stale mobile frame was rejected and recaptured.

checks.name: local automated regression
checks.details: 29 unittest cases plus 43 CLI contract cases; original software/industry outputs and historical snapshots preserved.

checks.name: repository preflight
checks.details: 15 checks, zero failures; both manifests 2.6.0, frozen sources, references, comparison and public-content scan.

checks.name: JavaScript syntax and git diff whitespace
checks.details: node --check site/site.js and board_feedback.js; git diff --check.

checks.name: responsive desktop and mobile
checks.details: Actual 1440x900 and 390x844 UI operations and captures; both document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. Workspace retains native scrolling.

checks.name: preview and normalized position
checks.details: Fit image 272.625x590 and original390x844 retain point (0.32,0.18) within 0.00003; full image and marker stage use same bounds.

checks.name: mobile annotation revision
checks.details: Review finding addressed: fit-width preview295x638.40625 instead of28% shrink; one primary dialog scroll, direct opinion-entry link, sticky object heading. Save top685.96 bottom727.96 within CSS844 height after entry; actual save confirmation observed.

checks.name: selection, screen isolation, draft, keyboard
checks.details: Choose candidate, fill note, switch desktop/mobile preserving per-screen note, reload readback, Tab in native dialog and Escape returns exact trigger.

checks.name: clipboard and browser export
checks.details: Actual normal copy receipt and downloaded workbench-feedback.json; board-feedback validates actual screenshot bytes and one note/one annotation.

checks.name: clipboard denied
checks.details: Private Permissions-Policy fixture forces denial: handoff details expand, summary focused and selected, visible manual-copy guidance.

checks.name: storage unavailable
checks.details: Private opaque-origin sandbox fixture: explicit unavailable-state guidance, in-memory selection/opinion remains usable. Does not promise persistence.

checks.name: storage sandbox download receipt
checks.details: IAB download event did not arrive in opaque-origin CSP sandbox; UI only reports file prepared. Normal-origin browser download and validator passed separately.

checks.name: media unavailable
checks.details: Private404 fixture: visible screenshot load error and disabled preview/annotation controls.

checks.name: scroll storytelling
checks.details: Actual phase0->1->2->0 via native scroll controls, mid-story reload restores phase1, skip exits to real workspace. No wheel hijack. Static-reading control reveals all three equivalent panels.

checks.name: no-script and mobile narrative fallback
checks.details: CSP script-src none leaves all three panels and links readable with no dead static control; mobile uses same sequential content and selected mobile actual annotation screenshot.

checks.name: system reduced-motion preference
checks.details: IAB exposes no media emulation. Source honors matchMedia and CSS preference, and same static path tested through product control; OS preference not changed.

checks.name: media production
checks.details: Built-in imagegen generated original conceptual hero cutout; inspected actual image and alpha; provenance in media.json. Actual product evidence comes from rendered HTML.

checks.name: portable package cold start
checks.details: 47-file public/account ZIPs; fresh public extraction runs workflow, board and actual feedback validation. Account identity and presentation preserved, only semantic version changed in original account manifests.

feedback_loop.observed_problem: Repeated workspace eyebrow and generic description displaced screenshot and actions.
feedback_loop.change: Removed redundant header copy while preserving project title and capture-context disclosure.
feedback_loop.result: workbench-desktop.jpg in same clean state; notes top357.242px, previews top328.945px; original2.5 notes top1103px. No claim of causal universal skill gain.

findings: Mobile preview too small and save action clipped
Mobile site desktop captures too small to explain feedback relation
response: Implemented fit-width mobile preview and direct form entry; actual save verified
Used actual mobile annotation screenshot via responsive picture source
second_review.followup: Root verified affected mobile flow and captures; no independent rescoring or independent motion interaction check.

limits: No production deployment or native mobile/device acceptance.
No all-browser, all-language, screen-reader or comprehensive WCAG AA certification.
Generated concept material is separate from actual UI evidence.
This case does not establish that every Oil project or skill was executed or universally improved.
